Guidance & outlook: Our current manufacturing facility remains fully booked through October '26 with an order book exceeding INR100 crores, providing a strong revenue visibility and operational confidence going forward.

In line with the strong demand outlook and our long-term growth strategy, the planned capital expenditure for Phase 1 has been enhanced with a total project investment now expected to Bhadora Industries Limited June 06, 2026 exceed INR75 crores.

We anticipate that, as the new facility will be operational by October, we anticipate that there will be some hiccups when we start a new plant, but we expect at least 15% to 20% of the new facility to be utilized in this financial year.
Growth & demand: Bhadora Industries Limited June 06, 2026 In terms of the current order book, as I said it's over INR100 crores.
But in terms of orders in the pipeline, we have filled tenders close to INR500 crores.

So in terms of the fulfillment of the numbers which I've already set, INR200 crores to INR225 crores of target, that is pretty much achievable and it seems in line with the order book and everything right now.
Margins & costs: Gross margin got impacted, but EBITDA margins we still could maintain.
When you will look at the financials, you will see that the cost of RM has gone up by close to 2%.
And now EBITDA margins we have improved to around 13.5% in the second half.
Capex & expansion: On the expansion front, I am pleased to share that the development of our new manufacturing facility is progressing well and is currently approximately 80% complete.

To support this expansion, a term loan of approximately INR40 crores has already been sanctioned, and the required working capital facilities have also been arranged, providing us with adequate financial resources for timely project execution and operational ramp-up.
The capacity is running on 100%, but being an old plant, you can say 80 to 85% is the kind of utilization which you can look at.
Balance sheet & cash: For Phase 2, we will look at it when it, I mean the tentative planning so far is to go with debt is the primary choice going further.
Risks & challenges: But overall, for the year, I think we have seen a decline.
So I mean we have been constantly trying, but due to some difficulties from the supply of machines, there were delays in terms of the supply for the new machines.
There were some delays in terms of the civil site as well.
